reading.taskTitle: P1 passes because the v2 frame requires the goal quoted as 「goal」; P2 paraphrases the same fact and fails G1 (uncovered task_achieved). N4.0's requirement line says 不写任务标题, so a text that obeys N4.0 cannot pass the v2 gate for this fact.
reading.time: P3 (vague) fails G3 with uncovered:f2:time; P4 with the planned exact value passes. N4.0 renders time as 时间经过 / 过去了一会儿 and forbids 具体时长, so a compliant text cannot pass G3.
